column1: # iri-reference acceptance vectors, from the RFC 3987 example text.
# RFC 3987 §2.2 derives the IRI grammar from RFC 3986's by widening iunreserved
# and the ipchar family with ucschar. format_iri_ucschar_test.go and
# TestIRIRejectsC1Controls cover the code-point boundaries of those sets. The
# official suite's optional/format/iri-reference.json reaches the network-path,
# absolute-path, relative-path, and fragment-only forms with invented non-ASCII
# strings; these rows build every reference form from the RFC's own example IRI
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.
